name: From The Ashes raises healing on allies below 35% health (#2014, 560561 only)
contract: #2014, first spell 560561 only: effect 1 is aura 360 (ASCENSION_MOD_HEALING_DONE_VERSUS_AURASTATE) with MiscValue 13 = AURA_STATE_HEALTHLESS_35_PERCENT, base 24 -> +25%. Unit::SpellPctHealingModsDone multiplies healing by it when the victim has that aura state (Unit.cpp:10033-10039). Probe: Cleansing Flames Heal 681141 to an ally. The same healing to the same ally at full health is unchanged, and 25% higher at 100 of 1000 health. The second spell 805492 (charge refund, category 654 present in no charge DBC) is inert and is not asserted here.

steps.label: Healing to the ally at full health before the talent
At full health the talent changes nothing
Below 35% health the caster heals the ally 25% harder
